root_cause: The content loop treated Instagram daily-winner and media-job readiness as global fatal prerequisites, so an Instagram-only provider/readiness issue could stop blog and LinkedIn work that has separate delivery obligations.
prevention: Instagram winner/media readiness may degrade the Instagram channel but must not abort unrelated blog or LinkedIn generation/publication.
Degraded Instagram state must stay explicit in stepResults; it may never be silently ignored.
Selection RPC failures remain fatal because they indicate control-plane failure, while a valid no-winner/media-not-ready outcome is channel-scoped degradation.
